metadata.er-tech-spec: title: looply · 用户订阅管理 实体关系图 version: v1.0 · 2026-06-09 tables: - name: email_subscription comment: 邮箱订阅状态 note: 订阅唯一权威源 · 主体=email · user_id可空 · source仅3个订阅入口 columns: - name: email comment: 邮箱(主体) constraint: PRIMARY KEY type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: status comment: 订阅状态 subscribed/unsubscribed constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: user_id comment: 账户ID(可空,注册后回填认领) constraint: FOREIGN KEY type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: source comment: 订阅入口 footer/popup/preference constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: updated_at comment: 最近状态变更时间 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: consent_record comment: 同意凭证流水 note: 合规审计 · 每次动作落一条 · 不可篡改 · source含退订触发来源 columns: - name: id comment: 凭证ID constraint: PRIMARY KEY type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: email comment: 关联邮箱 constraint: FOREIGN KEY type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: user_id comment: 账户ID(可空快照) constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: action comment: 动作 subscribe/unsubscribe constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: from_status comment: 变更前状态 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: to_status comment: 变更后状态 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: source comment: 触发来源 footer/popup/preference/email_unsub(二期补bounce/complaint) constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: ip comment: 操作IP(审计) constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: device comment: 操作设备UA快照(审计,非推送token) constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: created_at comment: 动作时间(不可篡改) constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: user_account comment: 账户(外部) note: 归用户中心/注册模块维护 · 本模块只读 · 注册不采集订阅,仅按email关联认领 columns: - name: user_id comment: 账户ID constraint: PRIMARY KEY type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: email comment: 注册邮箱 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: created_at comment: 注册时间 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: push_subscription comment: 推送订阅(二期) note: 二期 · 主体=device_token(APNs/FCM推送令牌) · 一用户多设备 columns: - name: user_id comment: 账户ID constraint: PRIMARY KEY type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: device_token comment: 推送令牌(APNs/FCM) constraint: PRIMARY KEY type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: status comment: 订阅状态 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: updated_at comment: 最近变更时间 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: sms_subscription comment: 短信订阅(二期) note: 二期 · 主体=phone · TCPA express opt-in columns: - name: phone comment: 手机号(主体) constraint: PRIMARY KEY type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: user_id comment: 账户ID(可空关联) constraint: FOREIGN KEY type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: status comment: 订阅状态 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: consent_type comment: 同意类型 TCPA express opt-in constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: updated_at comment: 最近变更时间 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: relations: - from: email_subscription to: consent_record type: 1:N label: email关联每次动作流水 color: '#1565C0' penwidth: 1.6 - from: user_account to: email_subscription type: 1:0..N label: user_id可空·订阅可先于账户·注册后认领 style: dashed - from: user_account to: push_subscription type: 1:0..N label: 二期 color: '#B0A0CC' style: dashed - from: user_account to: sms_subscription type: 1:0..N label: 二期 color: '#B0A0CC' style: dashed design_rules: subject_email: 订阅以 email 为主体,user_id 可空。支持未注册访客订阅(CAN-SPAM 管制邮箱而非账户) flat_per_channel: 按渠道分表平铺:email主键email、push主键(user_id+device_token)、sms主键phone。各表独立主键不共用主体,靠user_id关联,扩展加表不改既有表结构 register_link_only: 注册不采集营销订阅,注册模块也无订阅功能。本订阅模块监听注册事件:若该email已有订阅记录则把email_subscription.user_id从null回填(一次UPDATE)。关联认领不改变同意状态,不写consent_record,不污染同意凭证表。换邮箱注册=新账户,旧邮箱订阅保持user_id=null独立存活 source_two_layers: source两层语义:email_subscription.source=订阅入口(仅footer/popup/preference 3个);consent_record.source=每次同意变更的触发来源(订阅footer/popup/preference、退订email_unsub/preference)。两者不混用 consent_pure: consent_record只记同意的授予与撤销(subscribe/unsubscribe两类),用于合规举证。关联认领等不改变同意状态的动作不进此表 source_phase2_todo: 二期待补:硬退信(bounce)/垃圾投诉(complaint)类系统自动退订,EDM检测后写unsubscribe凭证。本期source不含这两值,归EDM抑制列表能力,二期再定协作写入 consent_immutable: consent_record每次状态变更落一条,不可篡改,用于合规举证。状态表只存当前态,历史进流水 device_not_token: consent_record.device是操作设备UA审计快照(如iPhone15·iOS18·Safari),与二期push_subscription.device_token(推送令牌)是完全不同概念 readonly_account: user_account归用户中心/注册模块维护,本模块只读关联,不写
